records.use: Primary public record for the processed example dataset, version, stated license and declared pipeline version.
Method context and reported example output-tree context; not a substitute for a file-level inventory.
Software provenance context only. This audit does not infer that the current repository state reproduces the processed dataset.

reportedFacts.statement: The public record identifies SpinalJ_example_data_processed as Mendeley Data version 1, DOI 10.17632/mkc37w4rrv.1, published 2021-07-19.
The public landing page records a CC BY 4.0 license for the dataset record.
The landing page describes preprocessed images, intermediate files, and outputs of registration, atlas mapping, and analysis derived from raw data.
The landing page states that the processed outputs were generated with SpinalJ v1.13.
The protocol reports distinct processed-section, enhancement, transform, and analysis output groups for its example workflow; these descriptions are context, not a verified manifest for this release.
No repository tag or commit is pinned by this metadata-only audit, so no current repository version may be silently substituted for the dataset-declared SpinalJ v1.13.

requiredBeforeFileAdmission: A stable file-level inventory with exact object names, sizes, MIME or format, and a source URL for every candidate asset.
A SHA-256 or independently reproducible checksum record for every acquired candidate file.
Native image dimensions, physical spacing, axis orientation, coordinate origin, and channel semantics verified from the acquired files and source documentation.
Transform files and their source-to-target coordinate-space declarations, without inferring a transform from visual resemblance.
A documented training-landmark set and a disjoint held-out landmark set with physical-space error calculation.
An asset-level reuse, attribution, derivative-distribution, and public-hosting decision that does not rely solely on landing-page metadata.
A curator-reviewed decision that the acquired asset may enter a source-local benchmark build; this decision cannot register unrelated project entities or NeuroMorpho SWCs.
scientificBoundaries: This record is metadata-only and includes zero downloaded candidate files, zero file hashes, and zero bundled assets.
SOURCE_LOCAL_OBS names the possible authority of future acquired source outputs; it is not a project atlas coordinate system or a REG grant.
No transform has been inspected or validated, so no source object, evidence entity, or NeuroMorpho SWC is registered by this intake.
The dataset-declared SpinalJ v1.13 is preserved as provenance; a repository version is not assumed compatible until a commit or tag is explicitly pinned and reproduced.
